decision.title: XML positions move back in place (P8)

body.p: . The position tracker of src/xml_encoding.c no longer restarts from byte 0 when asked for an earlier offset: it walks back from where it is, undoing line, column and input offset, and when a line end lies between it recounts the column from the start of that line; it restarts only when the start is nearer. The parser keeps asking for an element's position after its attributes' (and diagnostics may ask anywhere), so the fix is in the tracker, not in the call order. Cost is now linear in the document. Measured (release): sxml-qt4 list tests/qt4/torture-slice.txt 23.3 s before, 0.76 s after, same output; a 9.6 MB document with multi-line start tags did not finish in 600 s before, parses in 2.7 s after (about 70% of that is ts_parser_parse, so 's tree-sitter bounds parse speed at about 3.5 MB/s here). Tests: xml/positions_move_back (every pair of offsets against a fresh walk), xml/large_documents_parse_in_linear_time (10000 elements, 400 KB).
